rows: Crackles, throws sparks, leaps between fuel
Burns steady and bright, resists dousing
Flickers and shrinks from wind and from you
Collapses inward, burning black at one point
Grows heavy and slow, pools, soaks in
Flows as a steady pushing current
Rises as mist, lifts its level
Drains away, sinks into the ground
Overcast; the air goes dead and dark
Gathers into a storm or vortex
Grows strong and upright, holds against wind
Spreads and twines around what is near
Grows thorns, constricts, chokes its neighbours
Rings and shimmers; chips burst outward
Softens and bonds with what touches it
Sticks, heavy and slow to move
Gives way, falls from its hinges
Opens to you and your allies, welcomes
Shines steady, holds back the dark
Devoted to you; on enemies, dominated and possessive
Enraged, lunges, fixes on one target

items: Default reactions at intensity 1. Every emotion in a composition pushes at once: the strongest gives the primary action, the others act on free degrees of freedom or colour how it is done. Individual things can override a cell with their own reaction.
